required_evidence: Fresh UUID; no session merging
Loaded Bars calendar identity and iterator UTC intervals/trading dates
Startup sidecar alignment then independent READY/HELLO
Heartbeat continuity, max reader age 15 seconds
Valid forming and closed OHLCV, UTC close labels, tick and integer volume checks
Canonical unique chronological closes; no closed-session candle fabrication
Complete 15m and 1h bars after fresh observations
Zero broker calls, fills, account drift, journal writes and external authority
pass_criteria: All required observations and identity checks pass
fail_criteria: Malformed, stale, duplicate or out-of-order evidence
plans.activation: Start bounded harness BEFORE one fresh exporter activation; never replay prior evidence
plans.start_window: Any covered ordinary OPEN interval with at least 125 minutes before close
